title: Prepare and execute remaining V1 external acceptance gates
steps: Review every unchecked V1 release task and accountability-checklist item.
Run all locally reproducible PWA, export, package and deterministic checks.
Prepare explicit instructions and evidence templates for browser install/update/offline/touch testing and Android signed install/smoke testing.
Perform or assign accessibility, focus, contrast, responsive visual and original-brand review where a supported human/device target is available.
Keep unavailable device, provider, operator, licensing and human gates marked pending; do not infer acceptance from CI.
acceptance: Every remaining V1 gate has a named action and owner, locally verifiable evidence is recorded, and unavailable external gates remain honest blockers for release but do not block independent PR review.
